title: Predicting Live Birth After Fresh Embryo Transfer in IVF/ICSI: Differential ICM/Trophectoderm Morphology Encoding and a Hybrid Attention--Logistic Regression Ensemble
abstract: arXiv:2610.21134v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Predicting live birth before fresh embryo transfer could support shared decision-making in IVF/ICSI, but routine clinical data are small, heterogeneous, and contain pathway-dependent variables prone to outcome leakage. We aimed to construct a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and develop a prediction model suited to small tabular clinical data. \textit{Materials and Methods:} We assembled 616 fresh embryo-transfer cycles (251 live birth, 365 non-live birth) with clinical, laboratory, and embryological predictors, and embryo morphology encoded with a novel differential weighting of the inner cell mass and trophectoderm. After KNN imputation, robust scaling, and selection of 50 features, we developed a Hybrid Attention Network (HAN), a learnable feature-attention gate followed by a compact multilayer perceptron, and a HAN + logistic-regression (LR) ensemble with a validation-tuned weight. Models were benchmarked against classical mach

translated_title: 预测IVF/ICSI鲜胚移植后的活产：差异化的内细胞团/滋养外胚层形态编码与混合注意力-逻辑回归集成模型
translated_abstract: 在鲜胚移植前预测活产可以支持IVF/ICSI（体外受精/卵胞浆内单精子注射）治疗中的医患共同决策，但常规临床数据规模小、异质性强，且包含易导致结果泄露的依赖治疗路径的变量。本研究旨在构建一个精心整理的单中心IVF/ICSI数据集，并开发适用于小型表格临床数据的预测模型。材料与方法：我们收集了616个鲜胚移植周期（251例活产，365例非活产），包含临床、实验室和胚胎学预测变量，并采用一种新颖的内细胞团与滋养外胚层差异化加权方法对胚胎形态进行编码。经过KNN缺失值插补、稳健缩放以及50个特征的筛选，我们开发了混合注意力网络（HAN）——即一个可学习的特征注意力门控后接一个紧凑的多层感知机，以及一个带有验证集调优权重的HAN与逻辑回归（LR）集成模型。这些模型与经典机器学习模型进行了基准比较（原文摘要在此处截断）。
tldr: 该研究构建了单中心IVF/ICSI数据集，通过新颖的内细胞团/滋养外胚层差异化形态编码方法以及混合注意力网络与逻辑回归的集成模型，实现了适用于小型临床表格数据的鲜胚移植活产预测。
en_tdlr: This study constructs a curated single-centre IVF/ICSI dataset and predicts live birth after fresh embryo transfer using a novel differential ICM/trophectoderm morphology encoding combined with a Hybrid Attention Network and logistic regression ensemble, tailored for small tabular clinical data.
